title: MySQL integrated: ADD COLUMN FIRST or AFTER lands at the end of the destination table

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: MySQL 8.4.13, integrated CDC, one run per position

symptom: ADD COLUMN ... FIRST and ADD COLUMN ... AFTER: the destination column lands at the end of the table. A row written after it arrived with the value under the column's name. The AFTER case also restarted the update with cause SCHEMA_CHANGE.
cause: Not established. With the column filter off, the source position isn't used.
effect: The column order differs from the source; the values are right by name.
fix: Select columns by name. Column order isn't kept (not tested with the column filter on).
